name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 73.3 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: Man vajadzīgas 3 biļetes uz rītdienu rītu.
entries.reference: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.

entries.source: Mūs ir 5 cilvēki, tostarp 2 bērni.
entries.reference: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.

entries.source: Mans tālruņa numurs ir 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: Lidojums ilgst 9 stundas un 25 minūtes.
entries.reference: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.

entries.source: Mūs ir 4 cilvēki un mums ir 6 koferi.
entries.reference: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.

entries.source: Numurs 214 atrodas otrajā stāvā.
entries.reference: Room 214 is on the second floor.

entries.source: Es ierados 3. oktobrī un izbraucu 9. oktobrī.
entries.reference: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.

entries.source: Cikos muzejs atveras svētdienās?
entries.reference: What time does the museum open on Sundays?

entries.source: Mans vilciens izbrauc 18:45 no 7. perona.
entries.reference: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.

entries.source: Pēdējais autobuss izbrauc 23:30 šovakar.
entries.reference: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.

entries.source: Man ir rezervācija pulksten 20:00 2 personām.
entries.reference: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.

entries.source: Vai aptieka atveras pirms 9 no rīta?
entries.reference: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?

entries.source: Ekskursija sākas 14:15 un ilgst 3 stundas.
entries.reference: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.

entries.source: Brokastis pasniedz no 6:30 līdz 10:00.
entries.reference: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.

entries.source: Cik maksā divvietīgs numurs uz 3 naktīm?
entries.reference: How much is a double room for 3 nights?

entries.source: Tas maksā 45 eiro, ieskaitot nodokļus.
entries.reference: This costs 45 euros, including tax.

entries.source: Vai ir atlaide 2 pieaugušajiem un 1 bērnam?
entries.reference: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?

entries.source: Biļete maksā 12,50 eiro par personu.
entries.reference: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.

entries.source: Vai varu samaksāt 78 eiro ar karti?
entries.reference: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?

entries.source: Cik maksā autobuss uz lidostu 2 personām?
entries.reference: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?

entries.source: Dienas ēdienkarte maksā 15 eiro ar dzērienu komplektā.
entries.reference: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.

entries.source: Adrese ir Calle Mayor 15, trešais stāvs.
entries.reference: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.

entries.source: Mana viesnīca atrodas Gran Vía 28, netālu no metro.
entries.reference: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.

entries.source: Vēstniecība atrodas Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Lūdzu, pierakstiet adresi: numurs 42, dzīvoklis 5B.
entries.reference: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.

entries.source: Tikšanās vieta ir Plaza del Sol, 3. vārti.
entries.reference: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.

entries.source: Vai šis ir ceļš uz Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Kur ir tuvākā autobusa pietura?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest bus stop?

entries.source: Pie luksofora pagriezieties pa kreisi un tad ejiet taisni 200 metrus.
entries.reference: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.

entries.source: Vai no stacijas līdz viesnīcai var nokļūt kājām?
entries.reference: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?

entries.source: Kura līnija brauc uz lidostu, 5. vai 8. līnija?
entries.reference: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?

entries.source: Atvainojiet, vai šī ir vieta 14A?
entries.reference: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?

entries.source: Kā no šejienes nokļūt vecajā pilsētā?
entries.reference: How do I get to the old town from here?

entries.source: Muzejs ir apmēram 15 minūšu gājiena attālumā no laukuma.
entries.reference: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.

entries.source: Lūdzu, izsauciet ātro palīdzību, kāds ir bezsamaņā.
entries.reference: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.

entries.source: Esmu pazaudējis pasi un maku.
entries.reference: I have lost my passport and my wallet.

entries.source: Kur ir tuvākā slimnīca vai klīnika?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?

entries.source: Man ir alerģija pret zemesriekstiem; vai šis ēdiens tos satur?
entries.reference: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?

entries.source: Kāds nozaga manu somu, kurā bija 200 eiro.
entries.reference: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.

entries.source: Lūdzu, zvaniet policijai. Noticis negadījums.
entries.reference: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
